pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, tan-colored polygonal regions with diffuse pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches exhibit a mix of rounded and soft-angular vertices, with relative spatial area decreasing toward the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of off-white inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial, with a relatively uniform pixel thickness that maintains connectivity across the visible flank and lower neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, characterized by a dense, brush-like textural edge against the blurred background.
